verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly claim automatic sync of deal details, notes, and next steps to CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce) and CRM querying via Otter AI Chat, plus pricing tiers list Salesforce/HubSpot integrations. However, these are pitch-page/pricing bullet mentions with no independent or hands-on confirmation of the CRM sync actually mapping notes to the correct contact/deal record, and community evidence focuses on privacy/accuracy issues rather than confirming CRM integration reliability. Missing for 10: independent verification of contact/deal-level record matching accuracy, detail on setup/field-mapping process, and hands-on user reports specifically about CRM sync behavior.
